tailoring_notes: Category mappings reproduce the supplied library; re-rank for each actual job description.
Avoid equating a mathematical visualization with CFD or aerodynamics expertise without direct evidence.
Do not rewrite or truncate URLs; duplicate 14 resolves to canonical 3.
Use no more than five demonstrations in a standard two-page resume, and fewer when space is limited.
